question: Among female patients born after 1980-01-01, find those who have at least one laboratory record with abnormal platelet levels and at least one (possibly different) laboratory record showing either abnormal fibrinogen or elevated total bilirubin. Return the count of such patients.

prediction.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_058") FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND T1."XCL_060" > '1980-01-01' AND T1."XCL_058" IN (SELECT T2."XCL_014" FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2."XCL_027" < 100 OR T2."XCL_027" > 400) AND T1."XCL_058" IN (SELECT T3."XCL_014" FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3."XCL_036" < 200 OR T3."XCL_036" > 400 OR T3."XCL_037" > 20)

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_058")
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_060" > '1980-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"
      AND (T2."XCL_027" < 100 OR T2."XCL_027" > 400)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"
      AND (T3."XCL_036" < 200 OR T3."XCL_036" > 400 OR T3."XCL_037" > 20)
  )

    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"

    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058"
      AND (T3."XCL_036" < 200 OR T3."XCL_036" > 400 OR T3."XCL_037" > 20)
  )
